name: derive
description:
Query Datalog-derived facts with provenance.

CALL WHEN:
- You need to explain why entity A relates to entity B
- You want transitive closure (related, reachable, isa)
- You need derived facts with explanation chains

DO NOT CALL:
- For raw entity retrieval (use retrieve_entities)

Cost: Cache hit is free. Cache miss computes Datalog evaluation.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: pred_promote
description:
Promote a derived predicate to durable materialization.

CALL WHEN:
- A derived predicate is queried frequently and you want faster access
- You want to persist inference results beyond the ephemeral cache TTL

Cost: Runs Datalog evaluation + writes to durable tables.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: derived_cache
description:
List all derived cache entries for inspection/debugging.

Returns up to `limit` rows sorted by computed_at DESC.

Use for: audit trail, debugging derivation results, reviewing cache state.
